Ten Speed Spokes Friday Morning Women's Ride

Newport, RI · Road

Ten Speed Spokes Friday Morning Women's Ride is a road group ride in Newport, RI. It rolls every Friday at 6:30 am from Ten Speed Spokes.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 5–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @tenspeedspokes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ten Speed Spokes Friday Morning Women's Ride group ride

An early Friday women's road ride from the shop in downtown Newport. About 20 miles, no-drop, with a way to peel off at 10. The shop also hosts a Tuesday interval session, a Saturday half-island social ride and a longer Sunday tempo ride from Empire Coffee.
